stem: The transport of water from the soil solution to the xylem of roots occurs by the apoplast and symplast pathways. Mineral ions can be transported dissolved in water.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the transport of water from the soil solution to the endodermis of roots by the **apoplast** pathway **and** explain why this pathway cannot continue at the endodermis.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Researchers investigated the mechanism of transport used for the uptake of potassium ions ($K^+$) into root epidermal cells at different concentrations of $K^+$ in the soil solution.
